newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot propane continues rise from sell off.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot propane continues rise from sell off.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices continued their slow follow through from last week's selloff, despite the fall in NYMEX crude oil futures, players said.
Dealings however, were quiet in midday trade on Tuesday amid an industry event in Texas sponsored by Conoco.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas spot propane traded 49.50 cents and 49.75 cents, a half cent build upon Monday's one cent gain.
Spot material in the Midwest rose a quarter cent to between 49.25 cents and 49.50 cents a gallon.
"This is a slow follow through from the selloff last week," said one Houston broker. "There are not many barrels though that are readily available to buy back."
In other liquid gases, Conway natural gasoline jumed about two cents due to buyers overtaking sellers.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
